prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Pet", "Sign in now to store your adoption certificate and sync your pet across desktop devices."]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Quick guide: drag pet to move, right-click for controls menu, double-click to open chat.", "Right-click for options menu; Drag to reposition on screen; Double-click to talk"]
2: ["Verifying Desktop Display", "We are confirming desktop overlay permissions so your pet renders smoothly."]
3: ["Choose & Preview Your Pet", "Instant Preview"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Assets", "We are generating desktop animations. You will receive a desktop alert when ready."]
5: ["Log in with your existing account to retain your adoption history and prevent pet resets."]
6: ["Adoption Certificate + Bonus Pack!", "Complete adoption to unlock your official certificate and 3 free desktop pet toys.", "Free Starter Pack Included"]
7: ["Select Your Onboarding Speed", "Choose a instant ready-made pet or create a fully customized companion in under 1 minute.", "Start Now"]
8: ["Click on any companion card to preview animations."]
9: ["System notification enabled: we will ping you as soon as your pet lands on desktop."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and bonus items.
